description: FIN-03 (val5): a fresh sweep of BETA.DIST for both shapes above 1, drawn after the density kernel was frozen (decision 0188 R4.2 for T-5107; seed "r4-T-5107"). Rows 2-101: shapes log-uniform in (1, 300], x log-uniform from 1E-9, 40% mirrored to 1 - x. Rows 102-201: one count (shape - 1) below 6 that is not whole. Rows 202-301: both counts below 6, every other row a pair of half-integers. D: the density; E: the cdf (observer, not predicted to be exact). Arguments have at most 12 significant digits. Sheet W (added after the review of an internal review, 117 rows): the density at 39 shapes, three x each: 33 shapes where a count (shape - 1, or n - k) is an ulp or three from 2, 3 or 4, or is j*2^-52, so that it rounds onto a whole number (2, 3, 4 or 5) while the Stirling walk adds 1, and 6 controls an even number of ulps from a whole shape, where no count lands (statistics.md "Stirling error at a count that is not whole"). A shape that is not a short decimal is a checked raw cell.
